Replace each with a real figure, fill source_url and as_of, set verified to true. Crime: 15 cities carry the 2024 Statistics Canada Crime Severity Index; 4 (Victoria, Quebec City, Sherbrooke, Fredericton) are not in the published table and are scored as unknown, not as average. Rent now comes from a supplied 1-bedroom average per city: studio ranges are that figure (-15%/+20%); shared and private rooms are DERIVED from it by ratio and labelled as derived. Near and far carry the same rent because the source has no campus-distance split. Food comes from a supplied provincial grocery table (single person, monthly) — provincial, not city-level, and groceries only: meals out are not counted anywhere yet. `meal_out` is the price of one full meal out, multiplied by the meals-per-week the student enters to give an eating-out line. Groceries stay separate.
